svg.title: A callout box for parts packed too tightly for their designators
svg.desc: Drawn to scale. A QFN, U3, with eight 0402 capacitors packed tightly beside it, 0.25 mm apart, so there is no room for a designator beside each one. A legend box is drawn round the group of capacitors. Next to it, a second, larger legend box acts as a map: it holds the eight designators, C11 to C18, each in the same position and turned the same way as its capacitor in the group, so a person matches each designator to its part by position. A straight legend line joins the two boxes. All of it is drawn in the legend.

g.text: Box round the tightly packed group
No room for a designator beside each
A line joins the two boxes
As straight as it can be
The callout box: a map of the group
Each designator where its part is
Drawn to scale. 0402 capacitors and a QFN-24, 4 by 4 mm. Designators 1 mm tall, legend lines 0.15 mm.
